guard: a frozen working seat is distinguishable from a progressing one; heartbeat freshness is not progress
why: A cell that only asserts working for a working seat PASSES AGAINST THE BUG: a frozen seat
also self-reports working. The discriminating cells are frozen-vs-progressing labels and
the control that a heartbeat can be fresh while last-assistant age is stale.
A1 treats missing observation as fresh progress, restoring the guess.
A2 prevents the stall branch from firing.
A3 changes the chosen five-minute policy to twenty minutes.
A4 flips the strict boundary so the exact five-minute point stalls.

mutations.name: A1 missing observation is treated as fresh progress
mutations.expectRed: no observation is progress unknown, not a guessed stall
mutations.cell: no observation is progress unknown, not a guessed stall

mutations.name: A2 stall threshold never fires, so a 25m freeze looks fresh
mutations.find: return ageMs > stallMs ? { kind: "stalled", ageMs } : { kind: "fresh", ageMs };
mutations.replace: return false && ageMs > stallMs ? { kind: "stalled", ageMs } : { kind: "fresh", ageMs };
mutations.expectRed: a frozen working seat is stalled, not attested working
mutations.cell: a frozen working seat is stalled, not attested working

mutations.name: A3 five-minute policy drifts to twenty minutes
mutations.expectRed: the exported stall policy is exactly five minutes
mutations.cell: the exported stall policy is exactly five minutes

mutations.name: A4 exact five-minute boundary stalls instead of remaining fresh
mutations.find: return ageMs > stallMs ? { kind: "stalled", ageMs } : { kind: "fresh", ageMs };
mutations.replace: return ageMs >= stallMs ? { kind: "stalled", ageMs } : { kind: "fresh", ageMs };
mutations.expectRed: the 5m policy is fresh at the exact boundary
mutations.cell: the 5m policy is fresh at the exact boundary
